description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit tests related to length restrictions of identifiers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides helper methods to generate strings of specific lengths for testing purposes.

classes.name: LengthRestrictionTestBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods to generate strings exceeding or within length restrictions for testing.

methods.name: generateStringExceedingMaxLength
methods.description: Generates a string longer than the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: generateStringExceedingMaxLength with prefix
methods.description: Generates a string longer than the maximum allowed length, with a given prefix.

methods.name: generateStringWithMaxLength
methods.description: Generates a string exactly at the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: generateStringWithMaxLength with prefix
methods.description: Generates a string at maximum length, with a given prefix.

methods.name: generateStringWithLength
methods.description: Generates a string of a specified length.

methods.name: generateStringWithLength with prefix
methods.description: Generates a string of a specified length with a given prefix.
